question: All of the following drugs are indicated in the treatment of bipolar disorder except?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Carbamazepine" -> "approved for mood stabilization" -> "used in bipolar disorder" -> 90% CHAIN: "Vigabatrin" -> "not typically used for mood disorders" -> "indicated for epilepsy" -> "not indicated for bipolar disorder" -> 85% CHAIN: "Sodium valproate" -> "approved for mood stabilization" -> "used in bipolar disorder" -> 90% CHAIN: "Lamotrigine" -> "approved for mood stabilization" -> "used in bipolar disorder" -> 90%
analysis: Vigabatrin is primarily used for the treatment of epilepsy and is not indicated for bipolar disorder. The other options, Carbamazepine, Sodium valproate, and Lamotrigine, are all recognized treatments for bipolar disorder.
